integrity: New quantitative small-q asymptotic derived from exact normalized series and known root characterizations; no claim of independent audit, independent authorship, or computer-certified proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed \(0<\nu\le1\) and \(q\downarrow0\) only; no uniform nu down to zero, no all-q ordering, no q-Bessel-Struve extension. Uses established real-zero factorization and a self-review; independent scientific validation is not performed.
title: Universal sharp small-\(q\) corrections for exponential radii of normalized Jackson and Hahn–Exton Bessel functions
